groups.name: Sức khỏe hệ thống - đang có số liệu

annotations.summary: Server errors rising: above warning threshold (0.5 %)
annotations.description: Impact: Servers are starting to return errors, affecting some features sporadically.

annotations.summary: Server errors rising: above critical threshold (1 %)
annotations.description: Impact: Servers are returning many errors, affecting every feature.

annotations.summary: Slow server response: above warning threshold (1 s)
annotations.description: Impact: Users notice actions taking longer than usual.

annotations.summary: Slow server response: above critical threshold (3 s)
annotations.description: Impact: Users wait a very long time or hit timeouts.

annotations.summary: EC2 servers overloaded: above warning threshold (70 %)
annotations.description: Impact: No user impact yet. May slow down if usage keeps rising.

annotations.summary: EC2 servers overloaded: above critical threshold (85 %)
annotations.description: Impact: The system is about to slow down or fail.

annotations.summary: Database running out of connections: above warning threshold (70 %)
annotations.description: Impact: No user impact yet. Saving and submitting may slow down if it keeps rising.

annotations.summary: Database running out of connections: above critical threshold (85 %)
annotations.description: Impact: Saving, submitting and learning-data writes will be slow or fail.

rules.title: Login volume dropped vs last week (warning)

annotations.summary: Login volume dropped vs last week: above warning threshold (0.6 x)
annotations.description: Impact: Fewer logins than usual; some users may be unable to get in.

rules.title: Login volume dropped vs last week (critical)

annotations.summary: Login volume dropped vs last week: above critical threshold (0.3 x)
annotations.description: Impact: Almost nobody can log in.

annotations.summary: Unhealthy server behind load balancer
annotations.description: Impact: Part of the servers cannot serve requests; the remaining ones carry extra load.

annotations.summary: External health check failing
annotations.description: Impact: A web address cannot be reached from outside.

annotations.summary: Monitoring signal lost
annotations.description: Impact: The system may not be broken; the monitoring link may be down. Check the data source.

annotations.summary: GA4 data lost
annotations.description: Impact: Panels fed by GA4 (logins, learners, exam screens) are no longer updating.

groups.name: Sức khỏe hệ thống - đăng nhập, thi, học tập

annotations.summary: Slow login: above warning threshold (2 s)
annotations.description: Impact: Users wait longer to log in but can still get in.

annotations.summary: Slow login: above critical threshold (5 s)
annotations.description: Impact: Users can barely log in.

annotations.summary: Login server errors rising: above warning threshold (2 %)
annotations.description: Impact: Some users get server errors when logging in; retrying works.

annotations.summary: Login server errors rising: above critical threshold (5 %)
annotations.description: Impact: Many users cannot log in because of server errors.

annotations.summary: Slow exam processing: above warning threshold (1000 ms)
annotations.description: Impact: Saving or submitting takes 1-2.5 seconds, no errors yet.

annotations.summary: Slow exam processing: above critical threshold (2500 ms)
annotations.description: Impact: Students wait a long time on Save/Submit and may be unable to submit.

annotations.summary: Exam Lambda slowest run: above warning threshold (3000 ms)
annotations.description: Impact: Some save or submit requests are slow; slow answers may be written late.

annotations.summary: Exam Lambda slowest run: above critical threshold (8000 ms)
annotations.description: Impact: Answers may not be saved in time, risk of timeouts.

annotations.summary: Exam errors rising: above warning threshold (0.3 %)
annotations.description: Impact: A few students see errors when saving or submitting.

annotations.summary: Exam errors rising: above critical threshold (1 %)
annotations.description: Impact: Many students see errors when saving or submitting.

annotations.summary: Slow learning API: above warning threshold (3 s)
annotations.description: Impact: Lectures, videos and practice sets open slowly.

annotations.summary: Slow learning API: above critical threshold (6 s)
annotations.description: Impact: Lessons barely open.

annotations.summary: Learning server errors rising: above warning threshold (0.5 %)
annotations.description: Impact: Some learning actions show server errors.

annotations.summary: Learning server errors rising: above critical threshold (2 %)
annotations.description: Impact: Many users cannot do or submit homework.
